overview.description: The xETFs NVDA Daily Income ETF (NYYY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund actively manages a portfolio designed to replicate the total returns of NVIDIA Corporation (Nasdaq: NVDA) through swaps and other derivatives. The fund maintains a daily synthetic covered call strategy to generate additional income. NYYY was launched on May 13, 2026 and is issued by xETFs.
